title: Boom Lab Runner
heading: Boom Lab
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Pick an effect in the toolbar, then click the sky.

1.name: Pop
1.note: A flip-book: next costume, five times.

2.name: Fireball
2.note: One costume: change size and the ghost effect.

3.name: Ring
3.note: Turn 360 / n before each clone: they point all the way round.

4.name: Sparks
4.note: Gravity: vy goes down a little every frame.

5.name: Smoke
5.note: Random size, place, start and drift; rise, grow, fade.

6.name: Blast
6.note: A full-screen flash and a shockwave, with a fireball and a ring.

7.name: Quake
7.note: The ground shakes, a little less each time.

8.name: Mega
8.note: Bouncing debris, and every effect at once. The whole lab.
